---
title: "Analyzing US Births and Basketball Recruits"
author: "Var Kurapati"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |> 
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(day_of_week, 
                              levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"), 
                              ordered = TRUE))

births_model <- lm(births ~ factor(year) + factor(month) + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)

births_adjusted <- births_tibble |> 
  mutate(pct_resid = (resid(births_model) / mean(births)) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |> 
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |> 
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |> 
  summarize(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(calendar_date = make_date(year = 2001, month = month, day = date_of_month))

calendar_resid |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2001-01-01"), y = -22, label = "New Year's", vjust = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2001-07-04"), y = -22, label = "July 4th", vjust = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = as.Date("2001-12-25"), y = -38, label = "Christmas", vjust = 1)
```
